title: OAC 0.2 Device Proof
description: A WebAuthn assertion from the person's passkey over one exact Consent token (spec 3.6). Not signed by OAC itself: the authenticator's signature covers authenticator_data followed by SHA-256(client_data_json), and the client data's challenge is SHA-256 of the Consent token's bytes.

consent.description: token_digest of the Consent token this proof is for.

signature.description: ES256, DER-encoded, as WebAuthn returns it.
